rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for physically repairing a broken or damaged object.

example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 laan6 dang3 ngo5 lei4 zing2 laa1

rows.note: Use this everyday expression when an illness, injury, or person gets better again.

example.english: Is your leg starting to mend?
example.jyutping: nei5 zek3 goek3 hou2 faan1 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this for correcting an error, fault, or other thing that is wrong.

example.english: Please mend the typos in the report quickly.
example.traditional: 你快啲改正份報告入面嘅錯字啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 faai3 di1 goi2 zing3 fan6 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 ge3 co3 zi6 laa1
